scope.local_runtime: Tests use local bare Git repositories unless a row states otherwise.
scope.hosting: A25/A26 also use the executed isolated GitHub resume record; this does not generalize to every host.
scope.process_scope: Authority concurrency tests use spawned processes, but do not test two distinct checkouts concurrently mutating one session.
scope.editor_scope: A30 uses deterministic in-process reader/fault hooks, not an independently scheduled editor process.
limits: No universal hosting or Windows requirement is inferred for A21-A24 or A27-A30.
Passing rows do not establish completion of the broader Design §25 gates.

classification_legend.proven_local: Executed local runtime assertions cover the stated requirement.
classification_legend.proven_hosting: Applicable executed hosting evidence supplements local assertions.
classification_legend.incomplete: A required postcondition or scenario is not asserted.
classification_legend.unverified: No applicable executed evidence was found.
